why_the_slice_was_not_completed: static/js/poll.js holds the ONLY task-creation submit path in the product. B4b-2 requires rewriting its reference handling into a canonical staged-file inventory with drag and drop, per-file cards, object-URL lifecycle, removal, target-switch preservation and a Packaging omission confirmation, plus roughly forty-five behavioural properties and seven inspected screenshots. I did not have room left in this session to write that and verify it, and a half-rewritten submit path would break the primary way work enters the system - a worse outcome than stopping.

b4b_2a_preflight.question: section 16 requires 'the project's established JavaScript test strategy'. Before writing 2A I checked what that actually is, because the answer decides how the whole slice is built.
b4b_2a_preflight.finding: there is no npm/jest/vitest toolchain - no package.json, no *.test.js anywhere. Two approaches exist in-repo instead.

approach_1_source_inspection.example: apps/pipeline/tests/test_2c1_composite_activation.py reads static/js into _JS and asserts on its text
approach_1_source_inspection.verdict: NOT suitable for 2A. Section 16 explicitly rules out tests that search for implementation phrases when behavioural testing is possible, and almost every 2A property - staging, ordering, duplicate filenames, object-URL revocation, FormData contents - is behavioural.

approach_2_real_browser.example: apps/pipeline/tests/test_browser_gate1.py - StaticLiveServerTestCase + Playwright, headless Chromium, 4 tests
approach_2_real_browser.verdict: THIS is the established strategy and the one 2A must use. Playwright is installed and already drove the B4a screenshots, so the harness is proven in this repo.
approach_2_real_browser.how_to_assert_object_urls: shim URL.createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL in page.add_init_script and record calls on window, then read them back - that makes the lifecycle requirements in section 8 behavioural rather than textual
approach_2_real_browser.how_to_assert_formdata: intercept the fetch via page.route or stub it in an init script and inspect the multipart entries, so 'staged files appear exactly once' is checked against the real payload

b4b_2a_preflight.why_2a_was_not_started: the slice needs a new staged-reference module, drop zones and aria-live in the template, state CSS, and - the risky part - rewiring poll.js's submit to build its payload from the inventory instead of the native inputs. poll.js holds the only task-creation path in the product. Together with roughly forty-five behavioural properties in a live-browser harness this is a full session's work, and I did not have room left to write it and verify it. Nothing was changed.
recommended_order_for_the_next_session: 1. static/js/staged_references.js - config parsing from #reference-config, inventory add/remove/list, object-URL lifecycle, FormData build. Pure and separately testable; touches nothing.
2. template drop zones + aria-live region + CSS states.
3. LAST: swap poll.js's payload construction to the inventory. One small, reviewable diff against a module that is already proven.

ref_files_bridge.deviation_from_brief: section 6 asked for a DataTransfer input.files sync as the compatibility mechanism. Reading poll.js showed its payload comes from its own REF_FILES global - populated by change listeners that CONCATENATE and then clear the input - and never from input.files at submit time. A sync-plus-change-dispatch would therefore duplicate every file, and a silent sync would carry nothing.
ref_files_bridge.mechanism: window.REF_FILES is an accessor property installed before poll.js evaluates: the getter derives {kind: [File]} from the canonical inventory (it cannot become a second inventory - it IS the canonical one, viewed); poll.js's success-path REF_FILES = {} lands in the setter and performs the confirmed-success cleanup (clear + rerender + revoke).
ref_files_bridge.native_inputs: ALSO mirrored per category via DataTransfer - observable and tested, but carrying no authority and dispatching no events
ref_files_bridge.compat_failure: if DataTransfer is unavailable, staging is preserved, an aria-live warning is announced (and never overwritten by the add tally), and #btn-submit is disabled so a task cannot quietly ship without its references
ref_files_bridge.removed_in: B4b-2A-3, which switches poll.js to DesignOSReferenceUI.appendToFormData

Fixed in CSS (ellipsis clip + position:relative on the button).
b4b_2a_2.wire_evidence: the E2E test intercepts POST /api/tasks/create/ and reads the multipart body: name="container"; filename="shape.png" and name="color"; filename="chips.pdf" present, no colour field, design_target product_container; after the fulfilled 201 the inventory, cards and object URLs are all cleared. confirm_profile_ui2b1.normalization: QUEUED (resume identity, no start log) / RUNNING (persisted ARIA start-log evidence) / COMPLETED (post-reconstruction status AND recorded .ai artifact) / FAILED (generation_error incl. RECONSTRUCTION_DISPATCH_FAILED, or task failed) / RECONSTRUCTION_STATUS_INCONSISTENT for record sets that do not describe one clean state (success status without the required output, generating without a resume identity)
confirm_profile_ui2b1.phase_progress_policy: phase is ALWAYS null in 1.0 — no persisted phase records exist and none were invented; progress is an indeterminate <progress> for active states; no numeric percentage anywhere (tested)
confirm_profile_ui2b1.artifact_policy: availability booleans only (ai/png); no path, storage key, MEDIA_URL, provider response or traceback; stored failure text is path-scrubbed ([path removed]) and bounded
confirm_profile_ui2b1.authorization: rides the existing /status/ endpoint (IsAuthenticated + IsTeamMember, non-leaking 403); payload None where not applicable
confirm_profile_ui2b1.polling_controller: poll.js interval fallback rebuilt: settle-then-schedule (never overlapping), generation token + post-await activeTask checks make stale responses inert (SSE refresh got the same post-await guard), terminal snapshots stop the loop (and loadTask never starts one), poll_after_ms from the payload clamped by POLL_MIN_MS/POLL_MAX_MS with POLL_FALLBACK_MS — all central constants; STATUS_RETRY_LIMIT bounded retries then a persistent note; STATUS_REFRESH_FAILED never claims RECONSTRUCTION_FAILED
confirm_profile_ui2b1.status_ui: _reconStatusHtml in the frozen confirmed panel: coarse labels (Queued for reconstruction / Reconstruction in progress / completed / failed / inconsistent), honest dispatch line, indeterminate progress, textual AI/PNG availability, timestamps, role=status + role=alert, snapshot-signature skip so identical polls never rebuild the DOM (no re-announcement, no focus churn); legacy rendering kept as fallback (2B-3V pins intact); existing Resume button preserved on FAILED
defects_found: /status/ was cacheable: Chromium served repeated polls from memory cache — Cache-Control: no-store added (a frozen status view in real browsers, found via Playwright)
pre-existing loop could paint task A snapshots onto task B after a switch (no post-await stale check) — fixed with the generation token
confirm_profile_ui2b1.test_gotcha: time.sleep blocks sync-Playwright event dispatch — request-event counters read stale until the next Playwright call; use page.wait_for_timeout

confirm_profile_ui2b2a.artifact_audit: artifacts are PackagingOutput FileFields (design_preview_ai = PDF-based .ai named container_task_<id>.ai; design_preview = optional PNG — pdf_to_png failure does NOT invalidate the AI per the existing contract); no per-artifact rows, hashes or timestamps persisted; fidelity reports live in the spec; /files/<path> is authenticated but NOT task-scoped, so a focused role-addressed endpoint was added instead of reusing it
confirm_profile_ui2b2a.result_schema: container_reconstruction_result/1.0 (services/reconstruction_status.py) — COMPLETED-only (None otherwise; a missing .ai downgrades the STATUS to INCONSISTENT and no result is fabricated); roles AI_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH / PNG_PREVIEW_ONLY; safe basename, role-fixed media types, size via a storage stat, sha256 honestly null (never persisted), validation_state RECORDED/NOT_RECORDED from the spec fidelity report; deleted storage is caught by the availability stat (available:false, no URL)
confirm_profile_ui2b2a.endpoint: GET /api/tasks/<id>/reconstruction-artifact/<role>/ (IsAuthenticated+IsTeamMember) — role selects the artifact (never a path), applicability rides the same status derivation, dielines root-bounded realpath, .ai ALWAYS attachment (never inline even though PDF-based), png inline with ?download=1 disposition toggle, non-leaking 404 for every mismatch, serving mutates nothing
confirm_profile_ui2b2a.presentation: render.js: awaiting_gate_2 with a result (or an INCONSISTENT status) ALSO shows the frozen confirmed panel beside the untouched Gate-2 approval UI; _reconResultHtml renders the AI source card (badge, meta, Download .AI, source-of-truth + concept-only sentences) and the PNG preview card (authorized img, object-fit contain, Open/Download, inline onerror fallback to PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE keeping the AI card intact); COMPLETED status wording now says the result is presented below (stale next-step sentence fixed via screenshot inspection)
confirm_profile_ui2b2a.test_gotchas: route interception of the panel-rendered proved unreliable in this Playwright build (compiled-regex and wildcard-suffix globs never matched; even a matching glob missed the real panel load while intercepting probe-injected images) — the client fallback test forces a 404 on the live img instead
confirm_profile_ui2b2a.screenshots: docs/roadmap/confirm-profile-ui-2b-2a/ — 7 images + manifest (ui2b2a_screenshot_capture.py); inspected; one wording defect found and fixed

confirm_profile_ui2b2b.retry_audit: the empty-body resume was authoritative but had two gaps: a DISPATCH-FAILED task (status generating_dieline + marker) answered "already running" WITHOUT redispatching, and an inconsistent completion (awaiting_gate_2 without the .ai) had no recovery transition at all. Worker-failure recovery already worked via the awaiting_container_profile CAS.
confirm_profile_ui2b2b.failure_classification: STATUS_REFRESH_FAILED (client-only, never retryable) / RECONSTRUCTION_DISPATCH_FAILED (retry = redispatch, spec-marker CAS under select_for_update) / RECONSTRUCTION_WORKER_FAILED (retry via status CAS) / RETRYABLE_RECONSTRUCTION_INCONSISTENCY (success state without its .ai — CAS from the post-reconstruction status) / RECONSTRUCTION_ARTIFACT_INVALID + TECHNICAL_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED (tampered/unexplainable records: no retry, adjudication first) / PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE (completed stays completed; no retry)
confirm_profile_ui2b2b.eligibility: retry block inside container_reconstruction_status/1.0 (eligible, reason_code, requires_owner_confirmation, active_attempt, existing_gate_decision_id, confirmed_profile_hash, attempts_so_far, action=RESUME_EXISTING_CONFIRMED_PROFILE); server-side eligibility is revalidated inside the retry request — a rendered button is never trusted. COMPLETED now also demands the .ai STORAGE OBJECT (stat), so record-without-object is an inconsistency.
confirm_profile_ui2b2b.reuse_not_reconfirm: every retry derives the dispatch payload from the PERSISTED confirmed record; one GateDecision throughout (tested across double clicks, replays, queue failures and full recovery); responses say replayed:true for no-op replays and retry_reason for accepted retries; container_retry_history (spec) + an actor-attributed AgentLog row preserve every attempt and its previous failure
confirm_profile_ui2b2b.exactly_once: task-status CAS (worker failure, inconsistent completion) and a select_for_update spec-marker CAS (dispatch failure) make each accepted retry dispatch once; dispatch after the transaction; queue failure re-marks DISPATCH_FAILED with an honest 502 and remains retryable
confirm_profile_ui2b2b.client: eligibility-gated "Retry reconstruction…" opener; native reviewed dialog (reuse statements, failure code, decision id, availability; Cancel autofocus, Review Confirmed Profile focuses the frozen summary, explicit Tab wrap, Escape=Cancel pre-dispatch and inert in flight, settled+in-flight one-shot guards); accepted retry → loadTask → QUEUED + polling resumes once; §12 ambiguity: reconcile through /status/ (accepted→render active; eligible→retry-again message; else RETRY_STATE_UNRESOLVED), never a blind re-POST
confirm_profile_ui2b2b.gate2_continuity: recovered completion renders result + Gate-2 approval UI together; clean results expose no retry; Gate-2 decision rows proven untouched by retry
